title: German Tagine Pasta
description: A German twist on traditional Moroccan tagine, this recipe brings together the comfort of pasta and the bold flavors of the tagine. Serve hot and enjoy!

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: you can use store-bought or homemade

ingredients.name: snappy
ingredients.notes: snappy carrot sticks, peeled and sliced

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat the tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced vibrant bell peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the snappy carrot sticks and continue cooking for another 5 minutes.
Stir in the cooked pasta, and cook for 1-2 minutes to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of polish mustard.
